ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneAttributeDef.label: potency
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneAttributeDef.description: Raw arcane might. Potency makes every spell hit harder and heal more, and it gates the most destructive nodes of damage-focused trees.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneAttributeDef.label: focus
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneAttributeDef.description: Mental discipline. Focus deepens the mana pool, speeds mana regeneration and strengthens anything the mage conjures or commands.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneAttributeDef.label: celerity
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneAttributeDef.description: Speed of thought and body. Celerity shortens cooldowns, quickens casting and lightens the step.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneAttributeDef.label: resilience
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneAttributeDef.description: Arcane fortitude. Resilience thickens the mage's ward, hardens the skin and steadies the mind.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneAttributeDef.label: attunement
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneAttributeDef.description: Harmony with the weave. Attunement grants critical strikes, longer-lasting magic and faster arcane learning.
